findings: An infiltrative pancreatic cancer measuring 48 mm is observed in the head of the pancreas. Serosal invasion and retropancreatic tissue invasion are noted. There is contact of more than 180° with the portal vein, suggesting invasion. No invasion beyond the inferior border of the duodenum is observed. No other local invasion factors are identified. Lymph node metastasis is observed in one node at station 14t. Osteolytic changes are noted on the left side of the Th8 vertebral body, raising suspicion of bone metastasis.
